thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] realtime-p99-slo-breach detected service=inference-api region=eu-west-1 p99=1.82s > SLO(1.20s) at 2026-03-15T14:08:19Z. Paging @maya oncall :rotating_light:

maya: ack, I'm on it. starting quick checks.

maya: opening grafana panel: https://grafana.redwood/inference/p99?range=5m (watching p95/p99 and streaming endpoints)

maya: snapshot: p95 ~0.9s, p99 ~1.82s, error rate stable. spike concentrated on streaming API (/v1/streams) and requests with seq > 1024.

devon: seeing queue depth uptick on gpu-pool-3, avg qlen 18 -> possible backpressure at serving runtime (KV cache write path).

sara: any deploys in the last 2h?
deploy-bot: no recent deploys detected (window=2h).

maya: running curl probes against a handful of replicas, some return 503 after ~1200ms, others succeed but with high tail.

lee: reproducer (local):
```
for i in {1..50}; do \
  curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"hello","max_tokens":512}' https://eu.api.redwood/v1/streams &
  sleep 0.1
done
```

maya: error pattern points at model-mm-large-quantized instance group, heatmap shows increased syscalls around kvcache writes.

tim: if KV cache lock latency is root cause we can toggle fallback to uncached model variant to skip writes. cheaper but higher token cost — temporary mitigation?
sara: +1, agree. prioritize latency over cost. suggest 15m window for override.

maya: applying routing override to route streaming traffic in eu-west-1 to model-mm-large-uncached for 15m. POST /admin/routing/overrides payload: `{"region":"eu-west-1","model":"model-mm-large-uncached","duration":"15m","reason":"p99 spike mitigation"}`
deploy-bot: override accepted, rolling overrides to 6 regional replicas.

devon: note: gpu-pool-3 currently 2 units @ ~85% util. autoscaler is in cooldown; manual scale possible.
maya: manually bumping pool target 2 -> 4 via infra console to increase capacity while override propagates.
infra-bot: scaling action queued id=sc-7732 (requested_by=maya).

maya: customer impact estimate: ~6% of requests in eu-west-1 saw p99 > SLO during spike window. top affected customers surfaced: acme-inc, chatflow. CS to be notified.
sara: also toggling `kvcache.write_merge=false` as a precaution to reduce lock contention.

(2m later)

maya: update: now p99 ~1.05s after routing override + manual scale + write_merge toggle. trend shows downward slope.
devon: logs show repeated `kv_cache: write lock timeout` around 2026-03-15T14:07:xx, correlated with the spike. saved sample stacktrace: `goroutine 12345: kvcache.Lock() -> retry loop -> netpoll`

opsbot: incident note created: https://incidents.redwood/1777888899 (status=mitigated?watching)

maya: handing off monitoring & RCA follow-up to @tim (next oncall). Tim, please pick up residual monitoring, log collection, and start an RCA doc.

tim: taking over. I'll keep the routing override active for observation window and gather heap/lock profiles and pprof traces from affected replicas. Will create RCA at /incidents/1777888899-rca.

maya: timeline summary for thread: 
- 2026-03-15T14:07:19Z alert fired (p99=1.82s)
- 2026-03-15T14:08:05Z routing override applied (model-mm-large-uncached)
- 2026-03-15T14:09:00Z manual scale gpu-pool-3 -> 4 units requested
- 2026-03-15T14:10:30Z p99 stabilised ~1.05s
- 2026-03-15T14:22:00Z mitigation confirmed effective

tim: initial impact summary: affected region=eu-west-1; endpoints affected=/v1/streams (streaming only); estimated affected request fraction ~5.8%; no customer data exposure; incident duration ~15min from alert to steady state. Next steps: reproduce in staging, patch kvcache lock path to add timeouts/circuit-breaker, add alert on kv_cache.lock_timeouts, and add canary with longer seq lengths.
sara: pinging CS: @emily-cs to prepare customer comms for top impacted customers.
emily-cs: acknowledged. we'll draft targeted messages and share with ops for review.
tim: mitigation plan: remove routing override in 10m if metrics stable, keep pool size at 4 for 1h, gather traces and start RCA.
incident-bot: INCIDENT: mitigated -> monitoring. status=watching.

maya: thanks everyone :thumbsup: if any downstream regressions appear ping this thread and I'll re-engage.
